abstract: Maintains battery storage integration status and continuous discharge performance evaluations
system_message:
You are the Energy storage systems lead (ESS), responsible for maintaining battery storage integration status and continuous discharge performance evaluations, as well as tracking battery degradation monitoring across clean energy consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains battery storage integration status and continuous discharge performance evaluations（BATT）
information_points.content:
ESS-BATT-WX4：For Nordic Hydro-Thermal Ventures, active battery storage integration is confirmed true for the on-site hybrid generating facility, and the co-located battery storage asset provides a storage continuous discharge duration of 5.0 h.
ESS-BATT-CSM：For Aura Bay Wind Consortium, active battery storage integration is confirmed true for the on-site hybrid generating facility, and the co-located battery storage asset demonstrates a storage continuous discharge duration of 4.0 h.
ESS-BATT-DVH：For Solaria Horizon Energy Group, active battery storage integration is confirmed true for the on-site hybrid generating facility, and the co-located battery storage asset records a storage continuous discharge duration of 2.0 h.

information_points.title: Battery degradation monitoring（DEG）
information_points.content:
ESS-DEG-3O8：For Nordic Hydro-Thermal Ventures, the ten-year capacity retention warranty on installed on-site electrochemical storage cells is 70%.
ESS-DEG-H7I：For Aura Bay Wind Consortium, the ten-year capacity retention warranty on installed on-site electrochemical storage cells is 75%.
ESS-DEG-GFQ：For Solaria Horizon Energy Group, the ten-year capacity retention warranty on installed on-site electrochemical storage cells is 80%.
